description: Gujarat launches 40+ AI use cases across departments to boost smart governance, digital services and AI-driven public administration.
body_lead: Gandhinagar: The Gujarat government has identified and initiated more than 40 artificial intelligence (AI) use cases across over 14 departments, marking a major step toward AI-driven public administration and citizen services. The initiatives cover key sectors including agriculture, healthcare, urban development, energy, and governance. Gujarat Future Technology Initiatives (GFTI) Launched To strengthen technology-led governance, the state has launched the “Gujarat Future Technology Initiatives” (GFTI) programme.
